svg.title: Starting effective federal funds rate and subsequent annual return
svg.desc: Two matched scatterplots of 68 annual observations from 1955 through 2022. The vertical scale is identical. Each dot is an annual return; no fitted line, causal estimate, or forecast is displayed.

g.text: Starting effective federal funds rate and subsequent annual return
